ABSURD
solution:
The correct answer is** 'sensible​.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Let us see the meaning of Absurd:

 
 
• Absurd: not at all logical or sensible; ridiculous. (जो बिल्‍कुल भी तर्कसंगत न हो; हास्‍यास्‍पद, बेतुका)
 
 
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• Batty: **mad; insane. (पागल)
 
• **Sensible: **(used about people and their behaviour) able to make good judgements based on reason and experience; practical. ((व्‍यक्ति और उसका आचरण) तर्क और अनुभव पर आधारित निर्णय करने में समर्थ; समझदार; व्‍यवहार-कुशल)
 
• **Certain: **completely sure; without any doubts. (पूर्णतया आश्‍वस्‍त; संदेह से मुक्त, असंदिग्‍ध)
 
• **Insane: **crazy or mentally ill. (पागल, विक्षिप्‍त या मानसिक रोगी)
 
 

 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the antonym for the given word is "Sensible."
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.
